info.title: Kumbh Setu Lost & Found API
info.description:
Case management for missing persons, found persons, lost items, and found items at Haridwar Kumbh Mela 2027.

All `/api/v1` endpoints except login and refresh require `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`.
Visibility is scoped by role and station; ids outside your scope return 404.
Errors use `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "details"}}`.

get.summary: Readiness: required dependencies and schema compatibility
get.description:
Required dependencies decide the status code. The malware scanner is reported but does not make the API
unready: uploads stay quarantined until it returns, and the rest of the system keeps working.
Responses name the failing check only. They never include connection strings or exception text.

post.description: Exchange username and password for a 15-minute access token and a rotating refresh token.
Rotate the refresh token. Presenting an already-rotated token revokes the whole session.
Revoke the current session. Its access token stops working immediately.
Start TOTP enrollment. The secret is returned once. Disabled unless MFA_MODE=totp.
Enable TOTP after the caller proves the current code. This is not phishing-resistant MFA.
Change your password. Every session, including this one, is revoked; sign in again afterwards.

Files are quarantined and scanned before they can be downloaded. 201: scanned (CLEAN, or SKIPPED_DEV in
development). 202: the scanner was unavailable; the file stays QUARANTINED and is retried automatically.
422 malware_detected: the file was infected and has been deleted.

post.summary: Run automatic matching for this case now
post.description:
Deterministic rule-based scoring (see docs/MATCHING.md). New suggestions are stored as PROPOSED,
AUTOMATIC matches for police review; nothing is confirmed and no case status changes.

404.description: Not found or outside your authorised scope

post.summary: Confirm or reject a proposed match (police and admins; not the proposer of a manual match)
post.description:
Confirming moves both cases to MATCH_FOUND (from OPEN, UNDER_REVIEW, ASSIGNED, or REOPENED) in one transaction.
It does not resolve or reunite: resolution is a separate status change with its own verification.
Send left_case_version/right_case_version from when review began to get 409 case_changed on stale data.
